ROOT.proceduredef: CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.WmrRodzice(@ID INT) AS BEGIN DECLARE @c int CREATE TABLE #rodzice (WMR_ID INT UNIQUE,Poziom INT) INSERT INTO #rodzice SELECT B.WMR_ID,1 FROM cdn.Wymiary AS A join cdn.Wymiary AS B ON B.Wmr_Id=A.Wmr_ParId AND A.Wmr_ID=@ID SET @c=0 WHILE @c<>(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #rodzice) BEGIN SET @c=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #rodzice) insert into #rodzice select B.Wmr_Id,#rodzice.Poziom+1 from cdn.Wymiary as A join cdn.Wymiary as B ON B.Wmr_Id=A.Wmr_ParId JOIN #rodzice ON A.Wmr_ID=#rodzice.Wmr_ID AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #rodzice WHERE #rodzice.Wmr_ID=B.Wmr_ID) END SELECT Wmr_ID,Poziom FROM #rodzice DROP TABLE #rodzice END
